understanding: Verify after t_bringup_clk reset that RX and TX FIFOs plus shift registers are cleared and LCR reads 00000011b for 8 bits no parity 1 stop before uart_config, reporting stale data or LCR mismatch as reset failure.
preconditions: Power-on reset coordination from t_bringup_clk complete with reset deasserted under SYM_RESET_POLARITY plus SYM_IDLE_CYCLES clock cycles on wb_clk_i
Clock period fixed per test as SYM_CLK_PERIOD with no dynamic change during checks
No uart_config programming before reset-value readback; checks run before init traffic
wishbone_bus owned for reads; serial_data held idle with no rx injection; modem_control_if held at maintained idle
stimulus_steps: WAIT for reset deassertion under SYM_RESET_POLARITY plus SYM_IDLE_CYCLES clock cycles on wb_clk_i
wishbone_bus: READ LCR via wb_adr_i equals 3 and SAMPLE wb_dat_o width 8 per f_lcr_addr
wishbone_bus: READ FIFO status via SYM_LSR_ADDR and attempt SYM_RBR_ADDR read with no prior traffic and SAMPLE results per f_fifo_check
serial_data: HOLD srx_pad_i at maintained idle and OBSERVE stx_pad_o idle to expose uncleared shift bits per f_shift_clear
modem_control_if: HOLD inputs at maintained idle without assuming inactive level
check_steps: COMPARE LCR read data masked 0xFF against 00000011b expecting 8 bits no parity 1 stop per f_lcr_expect and f_lcr_reset; IF mismatch THEN report LCR reset-value failure
COMPARE LCR bit2 equals 0 meaning 1 stop bit per f_stop_1; IF not 0 THEN report LCR reset-value failure
COMPARE Transmit FIFO empty indicator equals 1 meaning transmitter FIFO empty per f_tx_empty; IF 0 THEN report reset failure

COMPARE no stale Receiver Buffer data readable before init traffic per f_fifo_check and f_fifo_cleared; IF any byte readable THEN report reset failure; IF observation address unavailable THEN record q_rx_addr gap
coverage_steps: SAMPLE wishbone_bus monitor LCR readback value and reset-match result for reset-value coverage
SAMPLE wishbone_bus monitor FIFO-status reads for TX-empty and RX-empty attempt for reset coverage
SAMPLE serial_data monitor idle observation during reset window for shift-clear coverage per f_shift_clear
completion: WAIT for all wishbone_bus read completions plus SYM_DRAIN_CYCLES clock cycles on wb_clk_i then declare checks done
ENFORCE TEST_TIMEOUT_CYCLES as testbench operational limit not DUT timing
CLEANUP return wishbone_bus and serial_data and modem_control_if to idle and release coordination handles

facts.statement: Expect receiver and transmitter FIFOs cleared upon reset.
facts.quote: • The receiver and transmitter FIFOs are cleared.

facts.statement: Expect Line Control Register reset to 8 bits data, no parity, 1 stop bit.
facts.quote:
• The Line Control Register is set to communication of 8 bits of data, no parity, 1
stop bit.

facts.statement: Upon reset receiver and transmitter FIFOs are cleared.
facts.quote:
Upon reset the core performs the following tasks:

• The receiver and transmitter FIFOs are cleared.

facts.statement: Upon reset receiver and transmitter shift registers are cleared.
facts.quote: • The receiver and transmitter shift registers are cleared

facts.statement: Line Control Register at bus address 3 width 8 access RW for control connection.
facts.quote: Line Control Register 3 8 RW Control connection

facts.statement: Line Control Register reset value is 00000011b.
LCR stop-bit value 0 selects 1 stop bit.
Value 1 means the transmitter FIFO is empty.
Writing 1 to FCR bit 2 clears the Transmitter FIFO and resets its logic.
facts.quote:
Writing a ‘1’ to bit 2 clears the Transmitter FIFO and resets its
logic.

questions: What bus addresses and masks observe receiver-empty and transmitter-empty after reset, since only LCR address 3 and TX-empty semantics are documented?
What is expected Receiver Buffer read behavior when FIFOs are empty to define stale-data failure without guessing?
What are evidenced idle tie-off levels and owners for srx_pad_i cts_pad_i dsr_pad_i ri_pad_i dcd_pad_i and wb_sel_i wb_we_i wb_stb_i wb_cyc_i during readback?
Is FCR clear sequencing required before FIFO-empty checks and what is documented RX clear encoding versus TX bit2 clear?
How is shift-register cleared status observed and what serial_data monitor data_bits parity stop_bits apply for reset 8N1 idle?
